FLASHCARD · ANIMALS & SOUNDS · AGES 2 YEARS

Duck Flashcard for Toddlers

Quack is a funny word and a funny sound, and ducks are everywhere: parks, ponds, picture books. This card connects all of them in one go.

← CowPrevious cardSheep →Next card

What this card teaches

Turns bath time and pond walks into vocabulary practice without trying.

Make the sound

Tuck a washcloth under your arm as a wing and quack-waddle to the door.

What kids learn from it

Silly walks plus sounds anchor words in the body, not just the ears.

Print it like this

Laminate this card — bathroom air curls ordinary paper fast.

Grown-up tip

Ask the duck a question in quack and pause for the answer.

Teach it, step by step

Want the full walkthrough? Open the Duck lesson on the Learning Path.

One word, two lessons

The duck quacks here with its sound; over in Look & Learn the same yellow duckling waddles — card 03 of a fifteen-card deck where every picture has its own move.

From the Animals and Sounds for 2-Year-Olds class on the Learning Path.
